title: So helpful !!
body:
The reminders app from Apple is very helpful, useful and easy to use. I tend to be quite forgetful so I really need reminders for a lot of things, hello neurodivergent mind :-)You can customise your reminders for repetitive periods too. I’m using it every single days for my personal and professional life.
I recommend it highly !!
author: Pasha1304

title: Very good app
body: Very good app. Very useful to me
author: Taariq😉

title: App remains blocked
body:
HUGE issue- systematically app doesn’t respond. Ex when changing a date/time of a reminder it sticks to the original date, it doesn’t change to new date/time. Or when deleting a reminder, it refuses to en deleted!
I Use it a lot due to memory loss.
author: PetiTiwi

title: Almost the best
body: I think it is missing one important feature to earn a fifth star, that is better integration with the notes, email and calendar apps. The app agenda is better at this. I would love not to have to download a third-party app to fill this feature.
